views.title: Turns every blur into clear glass.

views.markdown: Replaces frosted blur with see-through glass across iOS 12: Control Center, notifications, folders, the dock, the lock screen and the app switcher. Bright glass edges, a soft inner glow and a highlight that moves as you tilt the phone.

- Clears every blurred surface, including Control Center's full-screen background
- Glass edges and a tilt-reactive highlight on panels, the dock and folders
- Frosted style if you want the blur back
- Adjustable blur, edge glow, shine and tint

1.2.1: new hand-drawn icon.

1.2.0: renamed from Liquid Glass to Sheer. New Clear Every Blur switch clears every blurred surface in SpringBoard, including Control Center's full-screen background, the lock screen, the app switcher and the dock.

1.1.0: new Clear style (now the default) that fades out the system blur so the glass is see-through. Frosted keeps the old look. Added a blur slider and a soft inner glow.

1.0.0: first release.
